**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Each player draws 7 cards.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Clockwise (unless a “Reverse” card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard.
• If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two (+2)** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color cards; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, the round ends. That player gets points equal to the sum of all cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Scoring** | • Numbers: face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two: 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the agreed‑upon point total (commonly 500) wins. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep a “Wild” card handy** – it lets you change the color when you’re stuck. 2. **Watch for “+4”** – you can challenge if you suspect the player had a matching color. 3. **Use “Reverse” strategically** – in a 2‑player game it acts like a “Skip.” 4. **Plan ahead** – try to keep a mix of colors so you’re not forced to draw often. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
